subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should `codexbar guard` become a stable public automation interface, and if so should its window contract be restricted to verified session/weekly providers or redesigned around provider-neutral lane identifiers?
rationale: The permanent provider/window vocabulary and exit-code contract affect public scripts and cannot be selected safely from implementation details alone.

options.title: Narrow the supported matrix
options.body: Allow only providers with verified session and weekly quota lanes, document that matrix, and expand deliberately later.

options.title: Use provider-neutral lanes
options.body: Expose primary/secondary or descriptor-defined lane identifiers and report each provider’s actual lane label in output.

options.title: Decline the interface
options.body: Keep quota reporting in existing JSON output and leave gating policy to downstream scripts.

recommendation.title: Narrow the supported matrix
recommendation.body: Allow only providers with verified session and weekly quota lanes, document that matrix, and expand deliberately later.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the explicit product-signoff target and merged the recent comparable CLI command expansion.
